notes: Back banner Red Bull replaces Kia. The dark navy banner fabric is matched reasonably well and the geometry sits flat on the LED. Compared to the original Kia logo (cleanly painted, flat), the Red Bull wordmark and bull silhouettes show a faint edge reflex / light ringing on the white strokes — visible in motion strips as the banner translates with the camera. No obvious bright halo, but a subtle brightness lift around the wordmark slightly out-paces the matte original. Colors track well; saturation a touch high on the bulls. Stable across early/mid/late motion strips with no temporal flicker.
